23:5: Because of the matter that they did not greet you with bread and water

let Him not see within you offensive objects
lest His word turn away from benefiting you.
23:16: Do not deliver a foreign slave to the hand of his master,
who escaped to you from his master.
23:18: There is not to be a woman from the daughters of Yisroel to a man slave;
and a man from the sons of Yisroel shall not take a woman servant.
23:19: Do not bring a harlot’s fee or payment for a dog to the house of Adonoy, your God, in fulfillment of any vow;
because distanced before Adonoy, your God, are even both of them.
23:21: You may pay usury to the foreigner,
but to your brother do not pay usury;
in order that Adonoy, your God, will bless you in all your commerce
on the land that you are coming there to inherit.
23:22: If you make a vow before Adonoy, your God,
do not delay in discharging it;
for Adonoy, your God, will surely demand it from you,
and you will be at fault.
23:24: Keep what you have articulated; and perform
whatever you vow; before Adonoy, your God, voluntarily —
whatever you say with your mouth.
23:25: When you are hired to enter your fellow’s vineyard,
you may eat grapes as you desire, to your satisfaction;
but you may not place it in your container.

you may cut off stalks by hand,

24:1: If a man marries a woman and consummates with her;
